name: Home Assistant REST API
description: The Home Assistant REST API allows you to interact with a Home Assistant instance over HTTP. You can read and set states, fire events, call services, render templates, and more. All endpoints require authentication via a long-lived access token passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
